Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api

Interface VoiceRouteHook

public interface VoiceRouteHook
Server-side extension point for voice routing (radios, global microphones, custom mutes...).

Register with CozyVoiceApi.registerRouteHook(VoiceRouteHook). All methods are called on the server thread while a player is talking, about every 2 ticks per talking player (the result is cached and used for the frames in between), so keep them cheap.

For per-route changes with access to the full target list, you can also listen to VoiceRouteEvent.

1.0.0

    • isMuted

      default boolean isMuted(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer sender)
      Blocks a player's voice completely (custom mutes, jail, permissions...). The result is cached for a few ticks.
      Parameters:
      server - the server
      sender - the talking player
      Returns:
      true to block all voice from this player

    • onVoiceNoise

      default void onVoiceNoise(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer sender)

    • routeExclusive

      default boolean routeExclusive(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer sender, float level, boolean selfMonitor, VoiceRouteHook.Sink sink)
      Replaces positional voice completely, for example a global microphone.
      Parameters:
      server - the server
      sender - the talking player
      level - loudness of the last frame, 0..1 (0 before the first frame)
      selfMonitor - whether the sender wants to hear themselves
      sink - where to put the recipients
      Returns:
      true if this hook built the route and positional voice must be skipped

    • routeExtra

      default void routeExtra(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer sender, float level, boolean selfMonitor, Set<UUID> heardLive, VoiceRouteHook.Sink sink)
      Adds extra recipients on top of positional voice (radios, cameras...).
      Parameters:
      server - the server
      sender - the talking player
      level - loudness of the last frame, 0..1
      selfMonitor - whether the sender wants to hear themselves
      heardLive - players who already hear the sender directly (read-only), to avoid duplicates
